The merge arithmetic in step 2 is wrong: the script computes `tmp = b + λ(f1 - b)` and then `out = tmp + λ(f2 - tmp)`, taking the second task vector against the already-merged tensor rather than against the unmodified base. That yields `0.36·base + 0.24·ft1 + 0.4·ft2` instead of the required `base + λ(ft1 - base) + λ(ft2 - base)` = `0.2·base + 0.4·ft1 + 0.4·ft2`, which is exactly the ordering hazard the specification calls out and far outside the 1e-5 relative Frobenius tolerance. Everything else (shared-tensor verification, the `merged == 48` and `len(out) == 114` checks, output path, dtype preservation) matches the specification.
